hero.title:
Huza abahinzi n'amasoko
meza no kugira
inyungu nyinshi
hero.subtitle: Porogaramu ikoresha AI ihuza abahinzi bato n'abaguzi bakwiye, itanga amakuru y'ibiciro by'igihe, ikanongerera inyungu abahinzi bishingiye ku isesengura ry'isoko.

features.heading: Ibyo umuhinzi akenze kugira ngo ate imbere
features.subtitle: Kuva kuvumbura isoko kugeza ku giciro cy'igihe — porogaramu yacu ishyira imbaraga mu maboko ya buri muhinzi.

smartMatching.title: Guhuza mu buhanga
smartMatching.desc: AI iguhuza n'abaguzi baguha inyungu nyinshi ukurikije ibihingwa byawe n'aho uherereye.

realTimePricing.title: Igiciro cy'igihe
realTimePricing.desc: Amakuru y'isoko y'igihe kugira ngo ugurishe igihe gikwiye kandi wongere inyungu zawe.

cropInsights.title: Inama ku bihingwa
cropInsights.desc: Inama zihuje n'ibyo ukeneye zishingiye ku makuru y'ubutaka, ibihe, n'ibyifuzo by'isoko.

logisticsNetwork.title: Umuyoboro w'ubwikorezi
logisticsNetwork.desc: Guhuzwa n'abatwara ibicuruzwa bemewe kugira ngo umusaruro wawe ugere ku isoko vuba.
